text: also if you could curb the whole 'copy copy copy copy' chain that forever grows... that would be nice. just do something like Cube(1) Cube(20) etc.

events.text: Replaced the outliner duplicate suffix chain with source-family numbering. Legacy names like 'Cube copy copy' normalize to Cube, existing numeric siblings are scanned, and the next duplicate becomes Cube (N+1); mirrors use a separate qualified family. Pure naming regression passes.
Verified duplicate-family normalization in the pure outliner suite and through the full editor bundle/build. Commit 88c4167a3.

resolution: Replaced endlessly appended copy labels with stable duplicate-family numbering. Legacy names such as Cube copy copy normalize back to Cube, existing numbered siblings are scanned, and the next copy advances to Cube (N); duplicating Cube (20) yields Cube (21). Mirror variants use their own qualified numbering family.
